items.description: Disposal of shed roof timber and broken glass
items.rationale: Material arising under 5.2.1(a), both elements indemnifiable so combined position is fine; reference case 8 prices (glass ~32, timber <75) suggest roughly 90-100.

items.description: Combined load: green waste, root mass >1 m³, soil
items.rationale: Root mass over 1 m³ and ground material are excluded under 5.2.1(d),(e); 7.1.10 means the whole combined position is declined.
Ground material under 5.2.1(d), standing-alone clearance with no reinstatement is not indemnified under 5.2.2.
Ground material excluded under 5.2.1(d)/5.2.2, and reference case 8 gave 0.
